Read-only research for Wave C of run 2026-11-09-ui-v3: the served-RPC inventory the v3 pages must wire to. NO edits, NO runs of tests/Playwright, NO installs.

Repo C:/Users/Dragonfly/Downloads/Warsha at integration tip 4c65ead (read crates/warshad/src/lib.rs and wave2.rs, crates/warsha-core, packages/client/src). Contract: docs/designs/UI_V3_PLAN.md sections 3.0-3.7 list the named actions per area (frame, onboarding, home, projects, project, inbox, bench, settings). For EVERY action effect that names an RPC, confirm the daemon actually serves that exact method today and record: method name, handler file:line, param shape (field names), result shape (field names), and whether it is stream/subscribe. Include at least: projects.create/list/get, runs.start/followup/advance/subscribe/artifacts, gates.list/approve/reject, budget.set/get, roles.set/list, models.list/add, providers.list/check_models, preferences/settings get/set, devices/pairings list/revoke, harnesses/skills/plugins/routines list+toggle, preview.start/stop, files tree/read, agent.turn/plan_mode/approve_mode/state, health, inbox sources.

Flag EVERY plan action whose RPC is NOT served (those must be dropped per UI_V3_PLAN section 6, never rendered). Also flag name mismatches between UI_V3_PLAN/client wrappers and the daemon (snake_case exactness).

Deliverable: write EV/research/served-rpc-inventory.md (EV=C:/Users/Dragonfly/Downloads/Warsha/bridge-io/policy/2026-11-09-ui-v3) as a table area -> action id -> rpc -> served? -> handler file:line -> params/result shapes -> notes; plus a dropped-actions list with reasons. Final answer UNDER 300 words: counts (served/unserved/mismatched), the dropped list, and any uncertainty. Do not edit state.json/PROGRESS.md/DECISIONS.md or any product file.
